headline: Bills celebrate new Highmark Stadium in style with big win
summary: The Bills threw a heck of a housewarming party for their new Highmark Stadium on Thursday, launching fireworks to open the night and then piling up points in a 41-31 victory over the Detroit Lions that felt more dominant than the final score indicated.

headline: Thursday Night Football: Josh Allen accounts for five TDs in Bills' 41-31 win over Lions
summary: The Bills quarterback threw three touchdowns and ran for two.

headline: Emotional All-Pro LB Campbell shoulders blame for Lions' loss
summary: Jack Campbell fought back tears while reflecting on Detroit's poor defensive effort in Thursday night's loss in Buffalo.

headline: After a poor 2025 at home, the Ravens try to turn the page when they host New Orleans
summary: Jesse Minter wasn't even with the Ravens last season, but the new coach seems to have a healthy grasp of how 2025 went so badly wrong for Baltimore.

headline: There's sudden urgency for old NFC East rivals as Commanders visit Cowboys following opening losses
summary: — There's a sudden sense of urgency as the Washington Commanders and Dallas Cowboys renew an old NFC East rivalry with both teams staring at an 0-2 start in division games.

headline: Rams Hoping To Have Aaron Donald For Week 2
